t: “Bess, You Is My Woman Now:” Documenting Images from the Larney Goodkind Papers | Amistad Research Center
s: African American bass-baritone opera singer William Warfield frequently sang opposite Leontyne Price, America’s first Black soprano to become a leading performer at the Metropolitan Opera. Their richly melodious rendition of “Bess, You Is My Woman Now” from George Gershwin’s opera Porgy and Bess foretold their personal love story as husband and wife.
